text:
devex: quick ping — opened PR #482 to update the Node quickstart + SDK example. small changes: clearer auth snippet, added streaming example, and fixed the env var name. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482

devex: TL;DR — reviewers: please check auth wording (we switched to RW_API_KEY), the streaming code sample, and that the path for installing @redwood/sdk is accurate. should be a quick docs review, ~10–15m.

jordy: on it, will skim after standup (~25m) :thumbsup:

maria: I can do a pass on the auth/security wording. quick Q — do we want to mention KMS integration in the quickstart or keep it in a separate security appendix?

devex: good q — keep quickstart minimal, just mention env var and link to Private/KMS guide. I added a TODO comment in the PR for the appendix crosslink.

sam: left two tiny inline comments: one typo in the streaming example and one suggestion to show a minimal error handler.

jordy: saw sam's comments — I can take the streaming fix. which part of the example? the `for await` loop?

sam: exact spot — the `for await (const chunk of resp.stream())` should be `resp.stream()` -> `resp.stream()` is fine but add `try/catch` around it. also suggest `signal` example for aborting.

maria: reviewed auth section, LGTM except one sentence: "store the API key in a secure location" -> suggest "store API keys in your KMS or secrets manager" for clarity.

devex: thanks — I pushed a small commit addressing sam and maria's feedback. also updated the env var name to RW_API_KEY in the example. new diff: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482/files

merge-bot: CI: checks passed (lint, build-docs), 2/2 required approvals missing.

jordy: approving now.

maria: approved.

devex: awesome — that should be enough. anyone want to hold the merge for a manual smoke test?

sam: I can run a quick smoke on my laptop in 10m. share the steps?

devex: steps in PR description; short version: checkout branch, npm ci, set RW_API_KEY, run `npm run docs:serve` then follow the Quickstart example to generate a token. also test streaming snippet with `node examples/stream.js`.

sam: smoke test done — streaming example works and error handling behaves as expected. all set from my side.

devex: merging now, will post a short release note in #docs-updates once live. thanks everyone! :rocket:
